eatingOutPriceLevel.basis: Price level of restaurants and hotels relative to Finland, World Bank International Comparison Program 2021.
eatingOutPriceLevel.limitations: The programme prices restaurants and hotels together, so hotel prices are part of this figure.

coldestMonthMean.basis: Average temperature of the coldest month, Lisboa Instituto Geofísico, climate normals 1991-2020.

warmestMonthMeanMax.basis: Average daily high of the warmest month, Lisboa Instituto Geofísico, climate normals 1991-2020.

decemberDaylight.basis: Sunrise to sunset on 21 December at latitude 38.72°, calculated.

foreignBornShare.basis: Foreign-born residents as a share of the population of the city (Urban Audit, DE2009I).
foreignBornShare.limitations: Eurostat's figure is for its 'greater city' of Lisbon, which takes in neighbouring municipalities as well as the city itself. From the 2021 census; immigration has grown since.

carCommuteShare.basis: Share of journeys to work by car or motorcycle (Urban Audit, TT1012V).
carCommuteShare.limitations: From 2011, the latest year published; commuting has changed since. Eurostat's figure is for its 'greater city' of Lisbon, which takes in neighbouring municipalities as well as the city itself.

cityWide.basis: €17.43 per m² × 50 m², the app's assumed size for 1 bedroom.
cityWide.limitations: Median rent per m² of the new lease contracts registered in the municipality of Lisboa in the 12 months to June 2026 (INE, local rent statistics); no split by size. Per m² of private floor area.

rent.dwelling: dwelling of any size (20 to 600 m²)
rent.adjustment: Converted from a rent per m² at 50 m².

cityWide.basis: €17.43 per m² × 70 m², the app's assumed size for 2 bedrooms.
cityWide.limitations: Median rent per m² of the new lease contracts registered in the municipality of Lisboa in the 12 months to June 2026 (INE, local rent statistics); no split by size. Per m² of private floor area.

rent.dwelling: dwelling of any size (20 to 600 m²)
rent.adjustment: Converted from a rent per m² at 70 m².

cityWide.basis: €17.43 per m² × 90 m², the app's assumed size for 3 bedrooms.
cityWide.limitations: Median rent per m² of the new lease contracts registered in the municipality of Lisboa in the 12 months to June 2026 (INE, local rent statistics); no split by size. Per m² of private floor area.

rent.dwelling: dwelling of any size (20 to 600 m²)
rent.adjustment: Converted from a rent per m² at 90 m².

cityWide.basis: €17.43 per m² × 110 m², the app's assumed size for 4 bedrooms.
cityWide.limitations: Median rent per m² of the new lease contracts registered in the municipality of Lisboa in the 12 months to June 2026 (INE, local rent statistics); no split by size. Per m² of private floor area.

rent.dwelling: dwelling of any size (20 to 600 m²)
rent.adjustment: Converted from a rent per m² at 110 m².

1.basis: Electricity: 2,000 kWh a year (app assumption for 1 bedroom) at €0.2435 per kWh, the national household price with taxes.
1.limitations: Electricity use is an app assumption and varies with appliances, cooking and cooling.

2.basis: Electricity: 2,700 kWh a year (app assumption for 2 bedrooms) at €0.2435 per kWh, the national household price with taxes.
2.limitations: Electricity use is an app assumption and varies with appliances, cooking and cooling.

3.basis: Electricity: 3,400 kWh a year (app assumption for 3 bedrooms) at €0.2435 per kWh, the national household price with taxes.
3.limitations: Electricity use is an app assumption and varies with appliances, cooking and cooling.

4.basis: Electricity: 4,000 kWh a year (app assumption for 4 bedrooms) at €0.2435 per kWh, the national household price with taxes.
4.limitations: Electricity use is an app assumption and varies with appliances, cooking and cooling.

transitPassAdult.basis: Navegante Municipal pass for Lisbon, €30 a month; the Navegante Metropolitano for the whole Lisbon area costs €40. Both unchanged in 2026.
transitPassAdult.limitations: An unverified estimate: a news report (Postal do Algarve, December 2025) says both prices stay unchanged in 2026, matching the prices set when the passes began in 2019 (ECO); the operator's own price list was not read. To be checked before 1.0.

healthcarePerPerson.basis: Household out-of-pocket health spending per inhabitant in Portugal (€792.62 a year).
healthcarePerPerson.limitations: A national average across all ages; spending is lower for most working-age adults and higher for older people.

childcarePerChild.basis: Creche Feliz: nurseries for children under three are free in the social network and in the public and private nurseries that take part, including meals; the state pays the nursery. Public pre-school from three is also free.
childcarePerChild.limitations: Free places are limited to each nursery's capacity; a private nursery outside the scheme charges fees. Pre-school meals and after-hours care can cost extra.

carMonthly.basis: Autocost user data, as reported by Caetano: keeping a car in Portugal costs about €328 a month (€3,939 a year), including depreciation.
carMonthly.limitations: An unverified single claim from user-entered data, not tied to a car size or mileage. To be checked before 1.0.

groceriesPerAdultEquivalent.basis: Average spending in Finland on food and drink at home, €362 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 0.92 times Finland's.
groceriesPerAdultEquivalent.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

communicationsPerAdultEquivalent.basis: Average spending in Finland on phone and internet (services and devices), €70 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 1.20 times Finland's.
communicationsPerAdultEquivalent.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

eatingOut.basis: Average spending in Finland on eating out and hotels, €196 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 0.55 times Finland's.
eatingOut.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

recreation.basis: Average spending in Finland on leisure and holidays, €251 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 0.77 times Finland's.
recreation.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

clothing.basis: Average spending in Finland on clothes and shoes, €111 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 0.91 times Finland's.
clothing.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

waterPerPerson.basis: Water, sanitation and waste per resident, estimated from published claims for Lisbon: about €30 to €60 a month for a household's water bill (Mogul), and €60 to €150 for electricity and water together in a one-bedroom flat (Grey), which leaves roughly €20 to €60 for water after the app's electricity estimate. Taken as a household of two: about €15 a person, €10 to €30.
waterPerPerson.limitations: An unverified estimate from cost-of-living guides, not the municipal tariff; it assumes two people share the bill. To be checked against the tariffs before 1.0.

carRunningMonthly.basis: What remains once the car is paid for: the €328 less depreciation at 30 to 40% of the total, the share ADAC's figures give for Germany: about €213 (€197 to €230).
carRunningMonthly.limitations: An unverified single claim from user-entered data, not tied to a car size or mileage. To be checked before 1.0.
